description: The custom-collection limit is stated as a CLUSTER-wide cap of 1000 by configuration-schema-database.md ('1000 custom collections across the cluster'), but scopes-and-collections-config.md states the identical number as a PER-DATABASE cap, repeated verbatim twice ('You can define 1 custom scope per database with up to 1000 custom collections'). These are materially different constraints - a cluster with many databases could exhaust a cluster-wide 1000 far sooner than a per-database reading would suggest - and no page reconciles the discrepancy.
